criteria.requirement: Add spreadsheet_formula_policy(data,headers,formula_policy="preserve",**kwargs) preprocessor. Treat string cells/headers whose leading-whitespace-trimmed text begins =,+,-,@ as formula-like. Preserve default; escape prefixes one apostrophe to the exact original string; error raises with only one-based data row/column (header row zero), without exposing contents. Keep numeric negatives/nonstrings unchanged, operate lazily without mutating inputs and integrate through real CSV formatter preprocessors. Per-call policy must not leak to subsequent exports. Do not claim sanitization for every spreadsheet engine or rollback lines already consumed before a later error.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
